propositions: Destructive repair must establish durable, provider-neutral pause ownership before mutation, replacing GitHub-only gh workflow disable/enable safety.
Repair sequence must fail-closed: verify git identity, read existing pause (abort if foreign), create owned pause via CAS, verify lock safety, then mutate.
Cleanup must reread pause and OID as one snapshot, clearing only if reason matches invocation token, passing observed OID to release for CAS safety.
Missing, replaced, or changed pause during cleanup is an error; no recreation, no retry against fresh OID, failure leaves pause for operator recovery.
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair use the same repair-owned pause contract without public vocabulary or repair effect changes.
Local, GHA, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments must share pause behavior without gh binary dependency.
